I answered Hollis in a thread under the question in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of that channel, so this is something they could have looked up themselves. In my reply I also said not to mix it up with #8841, a different ticket about a Door 2 double-booking that came up in #central-random yesterday. No approval was needed, since a ticket number is an operational fact and not a finance figure.
